BiblicalUsage: This word appears once, in the margin of 2 Kings 16:6, as the reading behind the men who came to Elath in the days of Ahaz. Where the text reads Syrians, the margin reads Edomites, the sons of Esau coming to a port on the Red Sea.
TheologicalSignificance: One word in a margin carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the reminder that even the small print of the kings' wars was written down, and that Edom kept pressing at Israel's edges.
